Publish.LongDescription:
Discord RPC gives Cities: Skylines II a richer, configurable Discord presence without opening a second Discord connection.
FEATURES
• Live city activity, population, date, season, weather, temperature and optional traffic flow. • Private-by-default city names and configurable population/treasury precision. • Custom Details and State templates with readable tokens. • Session timer and activity preview. • Connection diagnostics, manual refresh and automatic reconnect attempts. • Companion activity for Access Studio, Road Rules, Event Engine and Traffic Stress Lab. • One-click disable restores the vanilla Cities: Skylines II rich-presence updater.
SAFE ARCHITECTURE
Discord RPC reuses the official Discord Game SDK client already created by Cities: Skylines II (client ID 1125009418476605441). It does not ship another SDK, request a token, launch a helper process or create competing Discord ownership.
PRIVACY
City name sharing is OFF by default. Population is rounded by default. Treasury is hidden by default. Save paths, account names and mod lists are never transmitted.
BETA NOTE
This package remains an unlisted beta until a real Discord desktop client accepts and visibly displays its activity during the release-gate test.
